newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 3.33 million barrels in the week ended Sept 6 to 309.82 million barrels from 313.15 million in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.

API said gasoline stocks fell 1.46 million barrels in the week to 191.36 million barrels from 192.82 million barrels. Distillate stocks rose 2.93 million barrels to 111.82 million from 108.90 million.
It said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 7,000 barrels to 37.892 million barrels from 37.885 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.42 million barrels from 14.40 million barrels. Percent of capacity rose to 94.7 percent in the week from 94.4 percent.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 34.77 million barrels from 35.72 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports rose to 7.37 million barrels per day from 6.73 million, API said.
